career_ladder.note: Computors (Sanganak / Statistical Enumerators) form the grassroots statistical data collection and computational staff under the Directorate of Economics & Statistics (DES), Planning Department, Government of Rajasthan. Governed by the Rajasthan Statistical Subordinate Service Rules, 1971, they conduct field price surveys, state domestic product estimations, agricultural output censuses, and demographic statistical computations.

exam_scheme.note: The Computor (Sanganak) Direct Recruitment Examination consists of a single-stage objective competitive written examination of 100 questions carrying 100 marks for a duration of 2 hours, followed by document verification of shortlisted candidates. For each correct response, 1 mark is awarded, and 1/3rd (0.33 marks) is deducted for each incorrect answer. Minimum qualifying threshold is 40% aggregate marks. There is no interview.

papers.paper_name: Part A — General Knowledge (Geography, Natural Resources, Socio-Economic Development of Rajasthan, History, Culture & Heritage of Rajasthan & Current Events)

Part B — Statistics, Economics and Mathematics (Collection/Tabulation of Data, Central Tendency, Dispersion, Moments, Correlation/Regression, Index Numbers, Time Series, Vital Statistics, Statistical System, Economy of Rajasthan & Computer Basics)

financial_package.note: Computors (Sanganak) are placed in Pay Matrix Level L-8 (Pay Band ₹9,300–₹34,800 with Grade Pay ₹2,800) under the Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2017. During the mandatory two-year probation period in Rajasthan, a fixed trainee remuneration of ₹18,500 per month is paid. Upon successful completion of probation, regular entry basic pay of ₹26,300 is drawn in Level L-8.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2017 Schedule Level L-8
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level L-8 entry basic pay of ₹26,300 at 58% DA (₹15,254 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (9% to 18%: ₹2,367 to ₹4,734), statistical field survey allowance, net of State Insurance, General Provident Fund, and RGHS deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per Rajasthan Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by posting zone (Class Y and Z cities)
Statistical field survey conveyance allowance and census touring reimbursements
Cashless medical facility across government and empanelled private hospitals under RGHS
Defined pension coverage under restored Old Pension Scheme (OPS)
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and annual privilege leave encashment benefits
